postprocessing.original_png: Unmodified copy of built-in tool output

intent: Narrow native homepage composition preserving the cloud field's irregular outer silhouette

references.role: composition, light, palette and upright ASCII texture

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Recompose the supplied atmospheric ASCII cloud field for a NARROW portrait canvas, 512 x 1536. Preserve its natural overlapping cloud structure, coherent lighting, luminous ivory and subdued blue-gray palette, and upright ASCII character texture. Redraw the composition for this narrower view; do not squeeze, stretch or rotate the artwork or its characters.
It must remain an unposed fragment of turbulent real sky: irregular large cloud masses partially beyond the top and left frame, much smaller vapor, overlapping veils, deeply recessed hollows, and a ragged edge that bulges outward and pulls inward unpredictably. Keep a complete visible irregular right-hand silhouette against generous pure white sky along the right edge. The outermost cloud should stay within roughly the left four-fifths of the narrow canvas, leaving white breathing room so a website will not have to slice through its billows. Use the same naturally broken wisps and clear sky near the lower edge.
No decorative column, triangle, gradual diagonal taper, rows of separate clouds, uniform scallops, counted clusters, repeated gaps, stacked stamps, line border, horizon, land, text, or objects. Do not make a neatly bounded cloud icon. Preserve the airy complexity and variation of the reference. Use pure white #FFFFFF wherever there is no cloud.
